mintAuthority.summary: USDat is a permissioned PYUSDx-backed MultiMint extension with native issuance on Ethereum. The current PYUSDx SwapFacility handles wrapping and is upgradeable by a 3-of-5 Safe. Separate five-day timelocks control alternative-asset caps and USDat proxy upgrades. The legacy MinterGateway and M SwapFacility no longer describe its current backing path. BNB and Monad are CCIP representations reviewed under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: PYUSDx SwapFacility extension router
controls.capDescription: The current USDat implementation wraps PYUSDx through this SwapFacility, subject to USDat's enabled compliance whitelist. Ordinary wrapping is 1:1 against PYUSDx; alternative-asset wrapping is governed by per-asset caps. This is not base-M issuance through MinterGateway.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095799, USDat swapFacility() returned 0x0bc305e7e13113caed3f5486849e9518a1cc4173 and pyusdx() returned 0xebdb0942ce16386ab90718c7bd10c91cdb66b14d. The facility's EIP-1967 implementation was 0xc37370ba22f8c565f64fdb4d85314c14d6bb3b3f and admin was 0xc421ccea39cc9858ba613052e84f04cc2b0df53b; that ProxyAdmin owner() returned Safe 0x48670b46380fe1645f0e3e821a25162db2589d19, independently verified as 3-of-5 with no enabled modules or guard. The legacy M SwapFacility's three-day timelock is not part of this new facility's admin ownership path. USDat's verified Extension._wrap transfers PYUSDx from the facility before minting; the facility admin does not by itself remove that local backing transfer. At Ethereum block 26095799, USDat held 85,981,412.404485 PYUSDx, equal to its native totalSupply. The verified Extension._wrap transfers PYUSDx from the configured SwapFacility before minting; totalAssets() tracks alternative assets and is not the PYUSDx reserve balance. Ordinary wrapping uses a 1:1 PYUSDx transfer-before-mint check in USDat, not MinterGateway base-M collateral attestations. Legacy M balance and cap are zero. The snapshot equality does not establish upstream PYUSDx/PYUSD custody or independent reserve assurance. Wrapping and unwrapping are compliance-whitelisted; isWhitelistEnabled() is true. The facility ProxyAdmin is directly owned by a 3-of-5 Safe; separate five-day timelocks govern USDat proxy upgrades and alternative-asset caps.

controls.label: PYUSDx SwapFacility upgrade Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095799, the PYUSDx SwapFacility ProxyAdmin owner() returned this Safe. getOwners() returned five owners, getThreshold() = 3, VERSION() = 1.4.1, getModulesPaginated(address(1),100) returned no modules, the guard slot was zero and the fallback-handler slot contained 0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99. The admin ownership chain contains this Safe directly, not the historical M SwapFacility three-day timelock. It can change facility logic, not USDat's separately timelocked logic or its PYUSDx transfer-before-mint check. At Ethereum block 26095799, this Safe required three signatures from five owners, had no enabled modules or guard and used Safe 1.4.1. Its recorded fallback handler is not a mint-cap or timelock guarantee. This Safe directly owns the PYUSDx SwapFacility ProxyAdmin. No timelock is present in that facility admin ownership chain; the separate USDat five-day upgrade and asset-cap timelocks do not delay facility upgrades. USDat's local PYUSDx transfer-before-mint check remains in its separately controlled implementation.

controls.label: USDat alternative-asset cap timelock
controls.capDescription: ASSET_CAP_MANAGER_ROLE can set MultiMint alternative-asset caps. At the observation block the legacy M cap and tracked M balance were zero, isAllowedAsset(M) was false, and totalAssets() was zero. The cap administrator can enable or resize alternative-asset admission after its delay.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095799, USDat's EIP-1967 implementation was 0x496a4a33b6181f4536203488d9a05ac1429e702c and admin was 0xcf1072da5f0d127aef99136489bad08bfa3d1a7d. ProxyAdmin owner() remained 0xfd5782e3bff366601da3973ae30c583de4f08a67 and getMinDelay() = 432000. This timelock also held USDat DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. Proposer/canceller 0x610182581c93687ca03f4a8e7f124f8cec616820 retained both roles and execution remained open to address(0). At Ethereum block 26095799, USDat's transparent-proxy admin is 0xcf1072da5f0d127aef99136489bad08bfa3d1a7d, owned by this five-day timelock. The controller also holds USDat DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. Its proposer and canceller remain authorized and execution is open to address(0); open execution does not itself skip the 432000-second delay. The current implementation transfers PYUSDx before ordinary minting and restricts alternative assets through raiseable caps. Replacing USDat logic after the upgrade delay can change those checks; the current reserve match is not an immutable economic ceiling.

capSemanticsReview.rationale: D14/A7 review on 2026-10-03 at ethereum block 26113622 (0x5f41a07faa7b201ebd6180fd900a8e50989c7d3ac2f09c64d5b5d6272ad71cb9): the canonical implementation remains 0x496a4a33b6181f4536203488d9a05ac1429e702c, and pyusdx() remains 0xebdb0942ce16386ab90718c7bd10c91cdb66b14d. Verified Extension._wrap transfers PYUSDx before minting; MultiMint._wrapAsset pulls the admitted asset, checks its received balance delta and only then mints the scaled amount. setAssetCap admits/expands deposit capacity but does not introduce a raw-mint entry point. PYUSDx yield and M-yield minting are constrained to actual excess token balances; disabled version-pinning cannot bypass these paths. A direct wrap simulation outside the SwapFacility reverted. Collateral admission and upgrade powers alone are excluded D14 triggers. Retain raiseable with raiseable-collateral-only proof; wrapper-local funding is assessed without reclassifying PYUSDx parent issuance, and no D29 certificate is authored.

review.evidence: Current native issuance was re-verified at Ethereum block 26095799: USDat is the PYUSDx-backed MultiMint implementation 0x496a4a33b6181f4536203488d9a05ac1429e702c, using PYUSDx SwapFacility 0x0bc305e7e13113caed3f5486849e9518a1cc4173. PYUSDx held by the proxy equals USDat totalSupply at 85,981,412.404485 units, while actual and tracked M balances and the M asset cap are zero. The enabled compliance whitelist gates wrapping and unwrapping. Separate five-day USDat proxy-upgrade and alternative-asset-cap timelocks remain active. The PYUSDx SwapFacility's ProxyAdmin is directly owned by a verified 3-of-5 Safe with no enabled modules or guard; it does not inherit the old M SwapFacility's three-day timelock. USDat's current verified Extension code transfers PYUSDx from the facility before minting. Historical MinterGateway and M SwapFacility control claims were removed from the current USDat path after the evidenced migration; their historical M0 facts are not evidence of current USDat supervision. D14/A7 review on 2026-10-03 at ethereum block 26113622 (0x5f41a07faa7b201ebd6180fd900a8e50989c7d3ac2f09c64d5b5d6272ad71cb9): the canonical implementation remains 0x496a4a33b6181f4536203488d9a05ac1429e702c, and pyusdx() remains 0xebdb0942ce16386ab90718c7bd10c91cdb66b14d. Verified Extension._wrap transfers PYUSDx before minting; MultiMint._wrapAsset pulls the admitted asset, checks its received balance delta and only then mints the scaled amount. setAssetCap admits/expands deposit capacity but does not introduce a raw-mint entry point. PYUSDx yield and M-yield minting are constrained to actual excess token balances; disabled version-pinning cannot bypass these paths. A direct wrap simulation outside the SwapFacility reverted. Collateral admission and upgrade powers alone are excluded D14 triggers. Retain raiseable with raiseable-collateral-only proof; wrapper-local funding is assessed without reclassifying PYUSDx parent issuance, and no D29 certificate is authored. This D14 refresh does not re-date older quorum or reserve-reconciliation observations. Reconciliation independently re-reviewed 2026-10-07 (GLM-R1 correction): the undated Saturn transparency page states All USDat capital is held directly in the USDat smart contract, verifiable onchain at any time. Its Accountable proof-of-reserves work and prospective Chainlink NAV feed concern sUSDat, not a completed USDat report. The pinned migration runbook, last updated 2026-08-20, describes one-shot migrate accounting, deposit-backed minting and post-operation verification; its Required records section requests per-operation accounting snapshots, not recurring whole-supply reports. The reserve analytics page displays Current USDat TVL $94,298,448 and Current USDat Reserve Ratio 100.00% with Last Updated: Every minute, plus rounded PYUSDx collateral $94.1M with Last Updated: Every hour, but exposes no dated common-clock whole-liability/backing reconciliation report. Neither the earlier single pinned reserve/supply equality nor mint-after-deposit mechanics establish a recurring report under owner ruling R9. Reject the unsupported continuous prior state and retain unknown pending a dated recurring whole-native-USDat liability-to-reserve reconciliation. Historical contract pins, cap semantics, control facts and supervision are unchanged; this review does not re-date their observations.
